speaker: Moisés Villanueva
title: “Prove Me Now Herewith”
summary: Elder Villanueva teaches that the Lord keeps His promise to open the windows of heaven for those who pay a full tithe, though often through subtle blessings that are easy to overlook. He tells how his mother, separated and raising eight children, chose to pay tithing after the family was baptized, and he sets her faith beside the widow of Zarephath, who fed Elijah first. He asks listeners to make their own list of the quiet blessings tithing has brought, as he did.
